title: DAY 4 — LESSON 1: UNDERSTANDING EMOTIONS AND EMOTIONAL TRIGGERS

questions.prompt: What is emotional intelligence in the workplace?
options: Recognising and managing emotions while responding thoughtfully to others
Always agreeing with colleagues and supervisors

questions.prompt: A supervisor corrects your work and you feel embarrassed. What is the most professional response?
options: Listen, seek clarification and respond appropriately
Immediately argue to protect your reputation

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes an emotional trigger?
options: A rule that employees must follow
Proof that another person intended to offend you
A situation or experience that produces an emotional reaction

questions.prompt: What should you do when you notice that you are becoming angry?
options: Send an immediate message expressing everything you feel
Pause, recognise the emotion and consider an appropriate response
Assume the other person is deliberately provoking you

questions.prompt: Does emotional intelligence mean remaining silent about unfair treatment?
options: No. Concerns can be communicated respectfully through appropriate channels
Yes. Professional employees must never express disagreement
Yes. Employees should accept every instruction without question
